mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.3 percentage point increase in unemployment rate over 3 months signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE rises >0.3pp over 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals supply-side disruption, reducing manufacturing output and construction activity, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls >5% and HOUST rises >2% from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO falls >5% and HOUST rises >2% from prior month, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, declining consumer credit (RSAFS) signals reduced household spending capacity, lowering corporate revenue expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of late-cycle expansion periods when RSAFS declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY change >0.5pp over 3 months) signals imminent monetary tightening, increasing equity risk premiums and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 0.5pp, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over 3 months signals labor market strength, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS increases for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In manufacturing slowdown regimes, industrial production (INDPRO) falling below its 12-month moving average signals production contraction, reducing corporate output and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of manufacturing slowdown periods when INDPRO is below 12-month MA, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and consumer credit (RSAFS) signals contraction in residential and consumer spending, reducing corporate revenue visibility and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST falls >3% and RSAFS falls >2% from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST falls >3% and RSAFS falls >2% from prior month, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.
